summary: Elephant and fort civ. Worker Elephants are mobile drop-offs, research finishes almost instantly but costs more, and Tughlaqabad Forts come in Feudal.

spikes.label: Feudal forts
spikes.detail: Tughlaqabad Forts act as keeps from Feudal and unlock Governors.
spikes.answer: Don't attack into the forts; expand and raid elsewhere.

spikes.label: Ballista Elephants
spikes.detail: Ballista Elephants are cheaper and faster to train this patch.
